description: Screenshot of Q drop #2043 dated Aug 31 2018 (tripcode Q !!mG7VJxZNCI, ID a67511), shown with a red header reading 'Aug 31 2018'. All content is the drop's claim.

description: Screenshot of a single paragraph of formal text on a white background. The passage, written in a president's voice ('My Administration'), objects to appropriations-bill provisions that condition officers' authority to spend or reallocate funds on congressional committee approval, calling them impermissible congressional aggrandizement. The filename identifies it as a February 2019 'Statement by the President' from the White House website (the signing statement accompanying the Feb 15 2019 appropriations bill); the image itself shows no header or attribution.
text: Numerous provisions purport, in certain circumstances, to condition the authority of officers to spend or reallocate funds on the approval of congressional committees (Division B, sections 702, 706, and 716(a), (b); Division E, sections 403 and 409; Division G, sections 188, 405, and 406). These are impermissible forms of congressional aggrandizement in the execution of the laws other than by the enactment of statutes. My Administration will make appropriate efforts to notify the relevant committees before taking the specified actions and will accord the recommendations of such committees all appropriate and serious consideration, but it will not treat spending decisions as dependent on the approval of congressional committees.
flags: Source attribution (White House statement, Feb 2019) comes from the archived filename, not from anything visible in the image

description: Choropleth map of the United States showing, per its legend, states offering driving privileges to unauthorized immigrants (dark brown) versus states offering none (green). Brown-shaded jurisdictions include Washington, California, Nevada, Utah, Colorado, New Mexico, Hawaii, Illinois, Vermont, Connecticut, Maryland, Delaware and DC; territory boxes (AS, GU, MP, VI, PR) appear below. The filename dates the map to July 2015 ('DL_Map_July2015'), consistent with National Conference of State Legislatures driver's-license maps, though no source is printed on the image.
text: LEGEND. States offering driving privileges to unauthorized immigrants. States offering no driving privileges to unauthorized immigrants. DC. AS. GU. MP. VI. PR.
